invariants.rationale: Compact or log compaction operations should always return a metadata object, never null, to reflect the operation's outcome.
The compaction instant time must be a valid string indicating the time of the operation.
The write statuses resulting from log compaction should always be present, even if empty.
The list of write statuses should be non-negative in size, as it represents records processed.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is necessary to carry out compaction operations.
